prompt: Compose one complete original 60-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: bright compact house; buoyant chord stabs with a memorable bass hook. Instruments: rounded kick, electric piano stabs, bright synth bass, shakers. Tempo 124 BPM. Distinct motif: a bright five-note arch. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 40-second reveal film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:58, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic track featuring a driving beat, synth melodies, and a positive, modern feel, suitable for promotional content.
